messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Install issues
parts:
Sorry for the frustration.

Can you get to a command window (type window + R, type "cmd", hit enter), then type "g++ -v"? Please report the result.

It should say "4.6.3" or "4.9". If it doesn't, you don't have the tool chain installed correctly.

I think Eric has a script to check installation on Windows. I don't have the location on hand.



Daniel
